correctness.rationale: Every edge lies in exactly one CC, CB or UB symmetry orbit. The displayed class-constant dipole potentials solve Lv=delta_x-delta_y; summing absolute voltage drops gives S_e and complementary Z_e=1+S_e-2R_e. The CB solution has a single absolute sign change at p=m-k=n, producing the two branch corrections. Exact positive-factor comparisons show CC cannot maximize either projection norm, while the signs of Delta_Q,Delta_P give distinct T_Q,T_P; their explicit gap 4(k+n)(n-1)/(n(n+2))>3 yields an interior integer phase. Algebraic upper bounds <4 and <5 for all admissible integers and the t,t^2,t^4 sequence realizes both limits. Independent exact inverses of grounded Laplacians checked all 621 edge columns on 10 graphs, but the unrestricted domain is proved by the orbit potentials and inequalities.

value.rationale: Cut/cycle Hodge operator norms on a connected graph are natural geometric invariants for graph transportation and flow decomposition. The three-orbit explicit classification and opposite-maximizer phase window across all sizes answer a structured perturbation problem and establish sharp amplification ceilings, reusable beyond finite examples.

final_claim: For unweighted K_{m,n} with a k-clique inserted into the m part (n>=2,k>=3,m>=k+1), the orthogonal edge-space cut and cycle projections Q,P have exact l1/linfty norms q0+max(0,Delta_Q), z0+max(0,Delta_P), with explicit rational piecewise corrections and distinct minimizing/maximizing edge-orbit thresholds T_P<T_Q for n>=5, plus sharp unattained family-wide suprema 4 and 5.
